items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: I see one night Joe, after the, after, after a beer, Joe sat on the piano

ctx.x: Mm-hm. I was there listening to you. What? I was there listening to you. Yeah, I was there. You still was playing when you were smiling.

Yeah. Yeah, all right, man. You could play anything, man. All that I could do was hit once. I'd pray. I see one night Joe, after the, after, after a beer, Joe sat on the piano and hit a note for the last thing to make that note. I need a little harder piano, man.
To the top of the piano, huh? What? Right up to the top of the piano range, huh? Yeah.
